title: neomammillaria macracantha
intro: Neomammillaria macracantha, commonly known as Pincushion Cactus or Stovepipe Pincushion, is a species of cactus in the family Cactaceae. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Neomammillaria macracantha include wound healing, reducing inflammation, and fighting off infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
